buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up

to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quoted Rate shall be inclusive of Supervisory charges, overhead, day to day expenses and Miscellaneous expenses, Police verification charges of resources, PPE’s, Expenses towards Employee Compensation Policy (ECP) or Workmen Co mpensation Policy (WCP), Group terms Life Insurance Cover (Rs. 10.00 lak hs), expense of annual medical check ups for the resources, it also includes all t he taxes, duties, charges towards tools & tackles, consumables, GEM transactio n fees as applicable as per GEM, all other expenses etc. towards satisfactory co mpletion of the work, including Good and Service Tax (GST). 2. Contractor shall quote in Rupees Above or Below the total SOR value (Incl o f GST) for service item 1060535 (Optional service item) as per NIT BOQ doc ument (Annexure-V). Accordingly, rates shall be back calculated for all the item s as per Annexure B. 3. Techno-commercial Documents uploaded list. A) The following Appendix’s of the Tender NIT are required to be uploaded along with your technical bid. a. Undertaking by the bidder in your company letterhead as per NIT (APPENDIX - XV). b. Holiday list declaration in your company letterhead as per NIT (APPENDIX - XI). c. NIL deviation statement as per NIT (APPENDIX –XIV). d. Declaration regarding MRPL directors as per NIT (APPENDIX - XIII). e. Undertaking with respect to Compliance of Restrictions for Countries which share l and border with India - APPENDIX - XVII - in your company letterhead as per NIT. f. Sealed and signed Conflict of Interest - Annexure XVIIII on stamp Pepar - NIT. Kindly fill in the required details manually in the NIT format and submit it as separate pages along with the Rs.100/- stamp paper with your seal & signature. g. Sealed and signed Integrity Pact as per NIT (APPENDIX-I - 04 pages).

h. Statement of Credentials as per NIT (APPENDIX-V). i. Other Appendix’s as per NIT document. B) Digitally signed document (on first or last page – any one page) or manually signe d (on all pages) - NIT, SOW, GCC & safety document. C) Work order and its completion details as per PQC requirement (APPENDIX - IX). D) Profit and loss account for the last three years and Net worth certificate with the U DIN number (APPENDIX - VIII). E) All other details as per PQC & tender requirement (APPENDIX - X). 4. Bidders shall select their Micro and Small Enterprise (MSE) status on the GEM tendering portal. Failure to actively choose and verify the MSE status, despite t he submission of valid documents for purchase preference, will lead to disqualifi cation of the bidder from participating in any purchase preference consideration s. MSEs participating in the tender must submit the Udyam Registration Certific ate. Policy is meant for procurements of only goods produced and services rend ered by MSEs. However, Traders or distributors or sole agent or Works contract is excluded from the purview of public procurement policy for MSEs Order, 2012 . 5. Indenting dept. Contact details: A.
